text: hey everybody I've been tagged in videos by a specific Creator recently that just show footage of what appear to be
ancient Jewish artifacts I'm going to share some clips from that footage and then I'm going to respond
now these artifacts are fake they are forgeries probably created within the last uh 20 to 30 years or so and there
are a handful of reasons we know this whatever Workshop produced these forgeries probably also produced the
jordan-led codices that were announced back in 2011. a lot of the imagery is very similar but a lot of the imagery
you see in here is based on existing imagery the Lions of Judah imagery for instance and sometimes they're even
pulling the menorah from the Israeli passport and adding lines to the side and and other kinds of imagery including
satanic imagery in an effort to kind of merge uh those ideas and evoke Judaism and Satanism together but the biggest
giveaway is that the texts are incomprehensible they're overwhelmingly gibberish they include characters that
don't exist mostly they are omitting very very common characters and some of these texts you never see like a giml or
a dolled or a Zine very common characters that should be there if this is actual ancient Hebrew and then in
some of these texts you just see characters repeated over and over and over again and patterns repeated over and over and over again which is a sure
indication that these are not the work of a trained hand or an actual scribe who knows the language but just somebody
copying off letters to fill the space on a forgery
